watch.summary: The streamer uses the OP sniper rifle in Valorant for the first time, repeatedly missing easy shots before finally landing a kill.

beats.what: Streamer boasts about helping his team with the OP sniper rifle.
Streamer misses his first shot completely.
He misses another shot on a nearby target.
A Mr. Bean waiting meme cutaway highlights his struggle.
He finally lands a headshot kill and screams in triumph.
Streamer laughs with his teammate in disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Get him out of my face!
watch.why: The clip works due to the dynamic shift between the streamer's initial confidence and his repeated inability to hit static targets. The pop-culture edit inserts and dramatic payoff cheer create a fun, relatable gaming fail clip.
